remarks:
Welcome to 62 Daisy Lane! Built in 2021, this beautiful two-story Colonial has it all! Featuring 4 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, and 2 half bathrooms, this home is completely move-in ready.

As you enter, you’re welcomed by an open-concept layout featuring a warm and inviting living room with plenty of flexibility for furniture arrangements. The kitchen and dining area showcase granite countertops, stainless steel appliances (included), meticulously maintained modern cabinetry, a large island with seating, and a convenient pantry. Also located on the first floor is a bonus room, perfect for a home office or additional flex space.

The second floor features four spacious bedrooms, each offering plenty of room to make your own. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and an en-suite bathroom complete with a double vanity. Bedroom two offers an impressive walk-in closet that rivals the size of the primary bedroom’s! With all four bedrooms located on the second floor, the conveniently situated second-floor laundry room adds an extra level of ease and functionality to everyday living.

Looking for additional living and entertainment space? The finished basement delivers! Offering an additional 547 square feet of finished space, complete with an egress window, this area features a dry bar, plenty of room to entertain or watch the big game, and a half bathroom for added convenience when hosting.

Step outside to enjoy the fully fenced backyard, where you’ll find a spacious stamped concrete patio, a pergola, and a designated fire pit area—perfect for enjoying those beautiful Buffalo summer and fall evenings. The well-maintained lawn and storage shed complete this inviting outdoor space, offering a backyard you’ll love looking out at from your kitchen window.

Built in 2021, this home offers the benefits of newer construction, with modern systems and features that have been well maintained by the current owners.

Offers are due Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 5:00 PM.

Showings begin immediately, open houses will be held Thursday 10/15 from 5-7pm, Saturday and Sunday (10/17, 10/18) from 11-1.
